correctness.rationale: Exact mgfs give the positive cubic and balanced quartic Cramer corrections, the positive case matches the published growing-shape Gamma maximum theorem, and the balanced saddlepoint expansion gives the stated tail ratio and Gumbel shift. Both spectra have r4=m and fourth cumulant 12/m; the critical Kolmogorov profile follows exactly from shifted Gumbel laws.

originality.rationale: Gamma triangular-array maxima and general Cramer-series corrections are prior art and are not claimed as new. Cai and Hu give a uniform effective-rank Gaussianization bound but no sign-sensitive sharp threshold. Targeted searches found no inspected source stating the paired same-r4 thresholds log^3 p versus log^2 p or the explicit critical Kolmogorov profiles.

value.rationale: The result identifies a missing sharp phase coordinate in high-dimensional signed Gaussian-chaos maxima: spectral sign cancellation removes the cubic correction and changes the effective-rank requirement by an entire logarithmic power, while the critical failure of Gaussian calibration is quantified explicitly.
